payload.rationale: This document is a minimal test memory authored by Tanya (staging) asserting that an omitted git ref triggers automatic topic branch creation. The primary narrative and actor nodes were expanded first, along with all five expression children (the repeated test instances across 2026-08-31 through 2026-09-02), so the passes can see the full lineage of this test phrase and bind the new instance correctly. Two positions were expanded: Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint (the next-sprint focus on context preservation, which this default-ref test directly bears on as a process/infrastructure behavior) and Position_Sprint4ThesisProven (Tanya's thesis that zero-effort capture works, which this test validates operationally). Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat was expanded because it sits under the same Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate umbrella and provides the product-vision context that frames why topic-branch creation matters. I deliberately did not expand the pricing or integration positions (PricingTier25Plus, ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, WebhookArchitecture) as they have no bearing on this test document.
